audienceHelp.logic: Within a field: OR · Between fields: AND
audienceHelp.example: Example: (Hanoi OR Hai Phong) AND the selected model AND at most 15 core days remaining. Leave a field blank to apply no restriction for that field.
audienceHelp.core: Unit: days. Enter only a maximum of 15 to select cores with 0–15 days remaining.
audienceHelp.loyalty: Unit: points. Enter only a minimum of 100 to select customers with at least 100 points.
audienceHelp.tds: Unit: ppm. Enter a minimum to select regions at or above that TDS threshold.
audienceHelp.tenure: Unit: days since the first device activation, rather than account creation.
audienceHelp.connectivity: Pick Non-IoT to target products with no cloud link (no telemetry); leave blank to include both. Note: any sensor condition (core/FW/TDS) excludes non-IoT units.
audienceHelp.snapshot: Counts unique customers, rather than devices. Customers who opted out of marketing or reached the shared send-frequency cap are excluded. This is a snapshot; eligibility is checked again at send time, including campaign-specific conditions.
audienceHelp.empty: No customers are eligible. Check or broaden the conditions, then preview again.
audienceHelp.invalidRange: Maximum must be greater than or equal to minimum.
audienceHelp.invalidNumber: Enter a nonnegative number; days and points must be whole numbers.
audienceHelp.all: All eligible customers in the current industry; no filters applied.
